mostWorthwhile.text: Making the imagined beast was most worthwhile: familiar remembered parts became something new, showing the creators making beyond what the world had supplied.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the pigment was straightforward but felt more like setup than a meaningful decision.

surprise.text: The echo becoming a song through a remembered, altered rhythm was an inventive transition I had not expected to happen so quickly.

arbitrary.text: Memory plus pigment made a cave painting, but the result gave no detail about its subject until the story was added. The connection was plausible, though compressed.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see what else the world's inhabitants create independently; the imagined beast and chorus made that possibility appealing.
